selection_rule: fastest passing candidate on the traced teacher-forcing metric; candidates within 0.3 t/s/u of it are a single-run TF tie, resolved by the 64-step token-out bench (model-only replay ms, repeatable to ~0.001 ms) when the tied candidates were benchmarked, else by the fewest policy changes vs baseline_s7 (skill tie rule); every measured reference must meet the bar; quality_gate_overrides.json can fail a candidate on the qualitative suite
